verdict.rationale: Kling's own docs claim native video output up to 4K (VIDEO 3.0/3.0 Omni), which covers the 1080p-or-above resolution part of the story without external upscaling or re-encoding. Nothing in the evidence documents selectable aspect ratios (16:9, 9:16, 1:1), so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented native 16:9/9:16/1:1 aspect-ratio selection, explicit resolution options (e.g. 1080p) per mode or tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration of output formats.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can render the aspect ratios and resolutions my channels need (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 1080p or above) without external re-encoding
